Painterly late-1990s Might and Magic science-fantasy concept art: clear painted forms, strong value structure, restrained surface detail, natural materials and even lighting. Neither photoreal nor glossy 3D, anime or cartoon.

TOP ROW, left to right: full stim canister, empty stim canister, full graft-serum vat, empty graft-serum vat. Allocate about 60 percent of sheet height to this row of larger props.
BOTTOM ROW, left to right: full colony satchel, empty colony satchel, full Kreegan scrap bundle, empty Kreegan scrap bundle.
Every prop is in front three-quarter view with camera slightly above, as the party looks down at these objects. Each pair must be the SAME physical object in the SAME pose/camera orientation and SAME display size, before and after use.
Candidate 1 specifically: TALLER SLIMMER CANISTER WITH THREE WINDOWS; VAT A NEAR-HEMISPHERE WITH DENSE THIN RIBS. These silhouettes must be clearly apparent.

COLOURED FLUID REGION:
Containers are designed for seven in-game colour variants on one model: red, yellow, blue, orange, green, purple, white. Here show only ONE full red canister and ONE full green vat, NOT seven variants.
The coloured fluid is ONE clearly bounded colour region per container: the canister's glass panes, or the vat's membrane and gaps between ribs. Lit evenly from inside with NO colour bleeding onto ceramic, gold, resin or bone.
Paint full canister fluid RED and full vat serum GREEN. Nothing else on EITHER container is red or green. Keep vat ribs and bone their normal dark-violet and ivory colours. All empty states have no glow.

EIGHT VIEWS IN READING ORDER:
1. FULL STIM CANISTER: colony and Ancient design, about 1 metre tall, waist-high. A taller slimmer upright cylinder of bone-white ceramic with gold bands, on a LOW ROUND FOOT. THREE tall GLASS WINDOWS around its middle reveal red glowing stim filled near the top; frame the view to read all three windows. A VALVE on top, a gold HAND WHEEL on a SHORT NECK. A small panel with ONE blue-white Ancient light, and a deep-blue livery stripe. Solid and simple enough to read at a distance. No hoses or loose parts. No red decoration: red appears ONLY behind the glass.
2. EMPTY STIM CANISTER: exact same canister, same pose, geometry, THREE windows, wheel, foot, bands, panel, stripe and parts. Glass DARK AND SMOKY, fluid completely gone (at most thin dull film at bottom), blue light DEAD. Nothing broken.
3. FULL GRAFT-SERUM VAT: Kreegan, about 0.8 metre tall and 1.1 metres across, squat NEAR-HEMISPHERE. Round black-violet resin vat with DENSE THIN VERTICAL RIBS and gaps showing green glowing serum. Pale bone claws grip the rim. THREE SHORT SPLAYED ROOT FEET. A MEMBRANE LID stretched over the top, taut, translucent and glowing green with the serum. Grown, not built. The membrane and rib gaps show one bounded internal green fluid region; opaque ribs, rim and claws retain their own colours.
4. EMPTY GRAFT-SERUM VAT: same vat, same pose, ribs, rim, claws and three root feet. MEMBRANE TORN OPEN, ragged flaps hanging INWARD; rib gaps dark; inside a visibly DARK DRY HOLLOW. No glow anywhere.
5. FULL COLONY SATCHEL: about 0.5 metre long, lying on floor. STUFFED CANVAS supply pouch in faded DEEP BLUE AND SAND, tan straps with GOLD BUCKLES. Flap CLOSED over top. Small colony patch SEWN ON FLAP: RED FIELD with GOLD RING AND STEM pictorial sigil, NO letters. Bulging with supplies; closed.
6. EMPTY COLONY SATCHEL: same pouch, SAME orientation, now OPEN AND LYING FLAT. Flap thrown back, straps loose, canvas collapsed and creased, NOTHING inside. Maintain the same material, strap and patch design.
7. FULL KREEGAN SCRAP BUNDLE: about 0.6 metre long, on floor. Compact bundle of looted scrap: a few bent IVORY CERAMIC PLATES, a GOLD FITTING and a CABLE END, bound in a wrap of BLACK-VIOLET RESIN. Closed with a BONE CLASP, a CURVED CLAW HOOK THROUGH A LOOP. Faint orange in resin seams ONLY. This is a resin-bound scrap parcel, not a chest.
8. EMPTY KREEGAN SCRAP BUNDLE: same resin wrap, SAME orientation, SPLIT OPEN AND FLATTENED, clasp undone and hanging, NOTHING INSIDE, NO GLOW. Clearly recognizable as the now-empty matching wrap.

FINAL CHECK: eight views in exactly the prescribed two-row/four-column order; same object and pose within each pair; taller three-window canister and densely ribbed near-hemisphere vat; red full canister and green full vat, colour confined to their fluid windows; dark empty glass, torn empty membrane and dry hollow, flat opened empty satchel, flattened empty open resin wrap. No text or letters anywhere, no scenery, no effects. Exactly 1536 x 1024 pixels.
